headline: Domdolus Tolus storms from 549th to 8th on ARC-2

sections.text: Domdolus Tolus gained 34.17 to reach 65.14, leaping from 549th to 8th and into the gold places.
The move clears a 48.33 gold line at 15th by a wide margin, putting Domdolus Tolus among the leading ARC-2 contenders.
